title: Week 9: Prosody begins
summary: Level 2 finished with a silver medal, and Prosody started well.
strengths: Pace is now in the calm 150s, close to a skilled TED speaker.
Fillers have dropped by two thirds since Day 0.
Follow-up questions build on the guest's answer almost half the time.
focus: Statements still rise on long sentences.
Pitch range is narrower than every reference speaker.
Volume drop at sentence ends (5.1 dB) is still above target.
persona_note: On pace you now sit between the TED and academic references. Pitch range is the clearest gap: about 2 semitones below the academic reference.
next_week: Week 3 of Prosody: falling intonation for statements and authority.
Extra practice: staircase-down claims, 3 minutes on busy days.
